image_description: Two wooden bookshelf loudspeakers stacked vertically. The top speaker has a reddish-brown wood finish, and the bottom one has a brighter orange-toned wood finish. Both feature a single large circular driver (woofer) with a grey cone and black rubber surround, mounted in a square baffle. No separate tweeter is clearly visible on the front face of either unit; they appear to be single-driver full-range speakers or the tweeters are integrated/obscured. The background is dark and out of focus.
